name: Stable Labeled Sample Compression of Singletons
details: The value field includes the one-concept case. Reconstruction may be improper for $n\ge2$.
proof: Use the stable unlabeled decoder: at $n=1$, always output the sole concept from the empty key. For $n\ge2$, retain the unique positive observation when present and otherwise retain nothing; output that singleton or the all-zero word, respectively. The decoder may ignore the retained label. Every intermediate sample containing the key makes the same choice, so the scheme is stable. Two distinct full concepts rule out width zero. Properness is not asserted.
